answer: Scarce Credential Garden. Each identity must hold a unique slot in a periodically renewed credential pool, allocated by lottery to existing agents; new identities only enter as slots open. The pool size is fixed, so mass registration yields no allocations—clones wait indefinitely while the nebula grows. Attackers must sustain many live agents to keep slot odds viable, and each idle identity pays recurring renewal costs. A single violet flag revokes the slot, making any clone campaign strictly negative-EV per identity.
